text:
Two-stage Miller OTA with an NMOS input pair, a PMOS mirror load, a PMOS common-source output stage and RC nulling.

```json
{"targets": [
  {"metric": "noise_1k", "op": "<=", "value": 50e-9},
  {"metric": "gain_db", "op": ">=", "value": 60},
  {"metric": "ugbw", "op": ">=", "value": 10e6},
  {"metric": "pm", "op": ">=", "value": 55},
  {"metric": "power", "op": "<=", "value": 1e-3}],
 "topology": "Two-stage Miller (NMOS pair, PMOS mirror, PMOS CS out, Rz-Cc)",
 "rationale": "Two gain stages give about 70 dB, where a 5T OTA cannot reach 60 dB. GBW = gm1/(2*pi*Cc) is set to about 14 MHz with Cc=3pF. gm7 of about 1.5 mS puts p2 well above GBW, giving PM above 70 deg. Rz moves the zero onto p2. A long-L, large-area input pair at gm/Id 15 keeps 1/f and thermal noise low. The NMOS input suits VCM=0.9 V. Supply current is about 10+35+250 uA, about 0.55 mW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gbw":    (14e6, 10e6, 30e6),     # design GBW target
    "Cc":     (3e-12, 1e-12, 6e-12),
    "gmid1":  (15, 10, 20),
    "L1":     (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),
    "gmid3":  (6, 4, 10),
    "L3":     (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "I7":     (250e-6, 80e-6, 400e-6),
    "gmidn":  (12, 8, 16),
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "kz":     (1.0, 0.6, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    gm1_t = 2*PI*p["gbw"]*Cc
    I1 = gm1_t / p["gmid1"]
    Itail = 2*I1
    I7 = p["I7"]

    # input pair (source ~0.2 V above vss)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load; M7 matched in density (same gm/Id, L) for zero systematic offset
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=0.0 + 0.9)
    m3.vds = None if False else None
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1).vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirrors
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref).vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.2)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    gm7 = m7.gm
    rz = p["kz"] * (1 + cl/Cc) / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1/(m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = gm7/(m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1*A2)
    ugbw = gm1/(2*PI*Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7/(cl*(1 + C1/Cc) + C1)
    p3 = m3.gm/(2*m3.cgg + m1.cdd)          # mirror pole (gives a LHP doublet)
    wu = 2*PI*ugbw
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu/p2))*0.3 - 0.5*math.degrees(math.atan(wu/p3))
    kT4 = 4*1.380649e-23*300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(2*kT4*0.8/gm1*(1 + m3.gm/gm1))
    noise_1k = vn_th*1.5                     # rough allowance for 1/f with large-area pair
    power = 1.8*(iref + Itail + I7)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm,
               "power": power, "noise_1k": noise_1k}
```
